fact: Eastern Cape Department of Health adopted online DHIS2 in 2017, and each facility's monthly routine data is captured into DHIS2 by a trained information cadre at the facility; data completeness for 2017-2020 was 74.6%.
title: Quality of routine health data in DHIS2 in South Africa: Eastern Cape province from 2017–2020
publisher: South African Journal of Information Management
